     (= CONFIG_SND_FSI_DA7210 true)
     (= CONFIG_SND_FSI_AK4642 true)
     (= CONFIG_I2C true)
     (= CONFIG_SND_SOC_AK4642 true))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_SND_FSI_AK4642 () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_SND_SOC_DA7210 () Bool
  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_SND_SOC_AK4642 () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_I2C () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_SND_FSI_DA7210 () Bool

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_44/52/91/92/102/106/107 (66517915e09.c), dead store on 'codec_hw_write' at line 16. CONFIG_I2C=true means i2c_master_send IS declared, so the known UndeclaredIdentifier vbdb bug does not apply here. The dead store is a simplification artifact — codec_hw_write is used as an I2C write function pointer in the real Linux sound driver. CONFIG_SND_SOC_DA7210=false means the da7210 driver path is not used, but codec_hw_write is still set in an ak4642 path and its subsequent uses were stripped.
